notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Arms Dealers![/p][p]The next update is ready, and this time we’ve addressed several bottlenecks highlighted by our community. Most notably, you can now expand your factory grounds regardless of the era. We’ve also implemented multiple quality-of-life improvements, including customizable notifications, semi-continuous production, and resource purchasing. Our focus remains on streamlining the game flow and enhancing your overall experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/65cc45f5219050bc6729e12355002d3613641640.png"][/img][/p][p]It is now possible to [b]reinvest[/b] your hard-earned cash directly into your Factory. You can expand your process lines or build additional admin offices without waiting for an Era change. Be cautious with your spending, though—these expansions are costly and can quickly push your maintenance expenses beyond your limits.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/3faab572062bbdc7c3a43e9e913cffa6458f7020.png"][/img][/p][p]As previously promised, we’ve now implemented the option to set [b]production to semi-automatic mode[/b]. Once an ordered batch of tanks is completed, production will automatically resume if there are enough resources and sufficient space in the warehouse.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/103a6d1aba4e5fca327ba49e278a78bcdcf1ed80.png"][/img][/p][p]A similar feature has been added to the [b]warehouse[/b], allowing you to reorder resources from the selected market, provided you have the space and funds available.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/f18209e74452df2bd6bd4c7d9687a23841e179a2.png"][/img][/p][p]In response to multiple requests, we’ve added the ability to [b]customize in-game notifications[/b]. You can now choose which types of notifications to display and whether they should pause the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/ef5ee563d98e96a84c35183db5ffa0dfed2183f3.png"][/img][/p][p]As always, we’ve introduced several [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] requested by the community. These include a new sorting option for the contract screen, a simplified tank design selection list in Test Drive mode, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/832ecfd0cd4045d323fbdfa25e79dafef858b08d.png"][/img][/p][h2]The Diplomacy Center[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/fc32aa719e9d26d791a1e839e1a9463bb417d2dc.png"][/img][/p][p]Here, you can now do everything previously only on the world map and in a much more easily navigated manner. Lobby for contracts, open and close trade offices, inspect countries, check the reputation, and whether they have any admins, it is all here now. I am sure you will like it, because I definitely do.[/p][p][/p][p]With these updates, we hope your gameplay experience becomes even more enjoyable![/p][p]FunGI Team[/p][p]
--[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Patch content[/b][/h2][p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.1.8.4
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

The next Hotfix is ready, and this time it includes much more than just a few bug fixes. To make the game experience more enjoyable for new players, we are introducing several new features aimed at making the learning curve less steep during the first playthroughs. However, experienced players can still choose to play in the old “ironman” style.


[list]
[*] [b]Government grants[/b] are a new mechanic that has been added to the game. With this new feature, each time you approach bankruptcy, the government will step in and subsidize your company with a certain amount of money. The amount and number of subsidies are limited and depend on the selected difficulty level. Note that for any difficulty level, you can always choose the [b]“Ironman” mode[/b], effectively deactivating this “grant” mechanic if you want to play without any compromises or “second chances.”
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/1RrnRBCV/Picture1.png[/img]
[*] Another new addition is a [b]useful hint added to the tank role assistant[/b]. Now, when you select a tank role in the Assistance tool, your engineers will advise you on which tank hull they recommend as a base for your tank design. Note that there is usually more than one way to create a successful design for any given tank role, so make sure to experiment until you find your best design!
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/50wHCSfG/Picture2.png[/img]
[*] Following the feedback, we have revised the [b]compatibility of alloy and assembly type[/b]. From this moment on, you are no longer limited to using contemporary alloy and assembly modifications for your structural components. Moreover, we have revisited the UI, hopefully making it easier and more user-friendly.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wz8h9pFw/Picture3.png[/img]
[*] We also added multiple QoL changes that were requested or voted on by the community. These include new s[b]orting options for the Contract Centre[/b], the possibility to [b]archive rival designs[/b] in Reverse Engineering, [b]limiting tank fame[/b] to avoid fame exploits in contracts, and others
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/tJpstnTg/Picture4.png[/img]
[*] Finally, we are very happy to add another language to the game. Now the game can be experienced in [b]simplified Chinese[/b] as well!
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/yY6JDRtQ/Picture5.png[/img]
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support!
FunGI Team

[*] Extended game localization to simplified Chinese

notes.title: WW2 Content Update released
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

We are very excited to share with you the WW2 Era  Update!

With a new World War approaching, the tank engineers are rushing to perfect their design and prepare them for the challenges that are approaching. Follow their tracks or design your own tank combining the technologies of the Interwar and WW2 era!

Starting [b]Monday March 31st 10:00 AM PST / 1PM EST[/b] the game will also have a [b]Daily Deal[/b] with a [b]25% discount[/b]! It's the perfect time to jump in and experience the game at it's finest!

[b]Update Summary:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]12 new vehicles[/b] added including British, German, Russian and American tanks. It is important to note that we will continue to add [b]WW2 tanks[/b] to the game as we continue the development
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0NFX76LS/Picture1.png[/img]

[*]A total of [b]170+ research nodes[/b] introducing new components, modifications, and expendables
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5yqPcsj5/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-201625.png[/img]

[*]The possibility to combine and mix components from the [b]Interwar and WW2[/b] periods
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DwzxDdhs/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-202817.png[/img]

[*]Tank role roster expanded with [b]12 new roles[/b] to account for WW2 vehicles 
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/xTnxGVF6/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-202311.png[/img]

[*]Expanded factory ground functionality with [b]new facilities, new administrator characters and additional process lines[/b] to pipeline your activities 
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ydRQj1Hb/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-201326.png[/img]

[*]Several important QoL improvements including [b]Part compatibility assistant[/b], [b]component and part archiving[/b] and [b]Design assistant[/b] in Engineering bureau and others
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9FbxJg6C/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-202434.png[/img]

[*]Extended possibility to select the Start era of your game into [b]WW2 period[/b]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zv1dPsDX/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-201737.png[/img]

[*]Game localization to [b]5 languages[/b] including German, French, Spanish, Russian, and Polish
[/list]

The new era brings a rebalance to certain aspects of the game. We believe that these adjustments will enhance the overall experience, making it more enjoyable and immersive. Additionally, we have dedicated significant time to implementing crucial quality-of-life improvements based on your continuous feedback on Steam and our Discord channel.

However, please note that due to the extensive nature of these changes, your saved game files will [b]not be compatible with version 1.1.8.0[/b]. Although we made every effort to ensure compatibility, the sheer magnitude of the alterations proved to be too substantial. To compensate for that, you can also select [b]the Era 3 for a start-up[/b]!
Thank you for your continued understanding and patience!
FunGI Team


[b]Patch content[/b]

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] WW2 Era content has been added, featuring new iconic British, German, Russian, and American tanks such as the Pz.VI Tiger, T34, IS-2, M3 Sherman, Churchill, Valentine, and others.
[*] The in-game time has been extended to 1953.
[*] The Research tree has been expanded to over 170 nodes.
[*] The game now offers the possibility of starting directly from Era 3.
[*] Twelve new tank roles have been introduced for WW2 tanks.
[*] Players now have the option to archive their tank and component designs and use this as a new filter option.
[*] A part compatibility tool has been introduced, allowing players to see compatibility between different tank parts.
[*] A "battle group" bonus has been added for tactical battles, reflecting support from regiments.
[*] A "Design assistant" has been added to the Engineering Bureaux.
[*] Assembly types have been expanded to include Welding and Casting assembly.
[*] A new WW2 opponent, the SPG, has been added to army units.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Administrator characters now retire at the age of 65. Please ensure you find a replacement in a timely manner!
[*] Countries are now less aggressive in abandoning obsolete tanks.
[*] Research node costs are now scaled according to the game difficulty level.
[*] Purchased rival designs now unlock not only individual components but also a draft of the rival design in the Design Bureaux building.
[*] The mass limit is no longer applied to tank designs in the Workshop. Create more diverse tanks and enjoy testing them on the Trial range.
[*] Components now only accept modifications from the same era as the component itself.
[*] Additional initial funds have been added.
[*] The process of saving selected tank roles in the assistant has been reworked.
[*] A tag has been added to Ongoing Conflicts where the player's tanks are involved.
[*] Revisited Administrator perks for Era 2
[*] Revisited bonuses for Workshop facilities for Production Hall.
[/list]


[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Corrected the supply's clause logic for the success score discount for the player.
[*] Resolved an issue with cloned designs that allowed the deletion of a parent design, even if it was being used in an active contract.
[*] Addressed an issue with cloned designs that led to incorrectly calculated attribute group sums.
[*] Fixed a bug related to the improper application of the "crew overload" penalty.
[*] Rectified an issue where lobby-generated contracts were not included in the contract numbering.
[*] Solved a problem that prevented players from painting tank designs in all colors at the beginning of the game.
[*] Adjusted tank roles selection for the assistant.
[*] Corrected an issue regarding the incorrect number of tanks in the "Accept contract" news.
[*] Resolved a problem with stuck resource delivery during an Era change.
[*] Fixed an issue related to sorting based on a tank's age.
[*] Corrected resource holding names
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V 1.1.7.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

The [b]1.1.7.0 Update[/b] is ready, and we are excited to release it to you!

As before, the patch introduces [b]new content[/b], several [b]important changes[/b] to the game, and several fixes based on your [b]feedback[/b] from Steam and Discord.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/RFfrrFZ9/Bild1.png[/img]

We continue to expand the world map. This time, it grew [b]eastward[/b] to include [b]Russia[/b], [b]China[/b], and [b]Japan[/b]. In addition to providing new battlegrounds and markets for your tanks, Russia introduces two new tanks from the Interwar Era: the [b]T18[/b] and [b]T28[/b] tanks. Inspired by the legendary Renault and Vickers designs, these tanks offer you even more options for experimentation and customization.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Pq0GFZh2/Bild2.png[/img]

Additional efforts have been made to revisit country logic. Now, countries will be more eager to [b]modernize[/b] their tank fleets with newer designs, raising their expectations for the tanks they are willing to purchase.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/P53nY97G/Bild3.png[/img]

Significant changes have been made to the Tank Contract system. We have now introduced a [b]Trade Office mechanic[/b], which serves as a trade representation for your company. You [b][u]must set up a Trade Office[/u][/b] in every country where you wish to engage in tank trade. Establishing a Trade Office incurs costs, so careful planning is essential to determine where to expand your company.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/JhsVqKws/Bild4.png[/img]

[b]Resource holdings[/b] are now part of the game. These holdings provide a stable income of a specific resource in exchange for a significant investment. As a player, you can choose to rely on external resource suppliers or reinvest your capital into resource holdings.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0jqT9szS/Bild5.png[/img]

[b]The Legal Centre[/b] is another addition to the game. Your lawyers are prepared to negotiate favorable conditions for tank contracts and labor unions, provided you have sufficient funds to pay for their services.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qBsfjzFx/Bild6.png[/img]

Finally, we have introduced [b]War mechanics[/b]. With this mechanics in place, wars will span [b]multiple military campaigns[/b], with the possibility of [b]allies joining[/b] the conflict. Countries will assemble even larger task forces to wage war, resulting in more intense fighting and, consequently, more frequent resupply contracts.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3NCPRcGc/Bild7.png[/img]

This patch also includes a significant amount of [b]QoL changes[/b], bug fixes, balancing adjustments, and text corrections. Don’t forget to check the complete patch details below or view the update notes directly in the game.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MKqC4z22/Bild8.png[/img]

As we move forward along the roadmap, the [b]WW2 Era update[/b] is beginning to take shape. Development is steady and in line with our plans.

We hope you enjoy this update, and as always, please don’t forget to share your thoughts and feedback with us!

FunGI Team

notes.title: Patch V 1.1.6.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

We’re excited to present our holiday gift: the [b]1.1.6.0 Patch[/b] is now available!

This patch introduces [b]new content[/b], several [b]important changes[/b] to the game, and numerous fixes based on your [b]feedback[/b] from Steam and Discord.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mrSWTsKD/USA.png[/img]

North America is now unlocked, with the [b]USA[/b] leading the charge. In addition to providing a new market for your tanks, the United States introduced [b]two new tanks[/b] from the Interwar Era: the [b]T1 Cunningham[/b] and the [b]M1921[/b]. Get your hands on these new tanks and experiment with combinations by mixing them with British, German, and French models.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/RhhBPDs0/T1-Cunnighma.png[/img]

Additional efforts have been directed toward quality of life improvements. To reduce clutter, [b]filter settings[/b] now allow multiple choices, enabling you to fine-tune them to your preferences in all scenes.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/GpPd9YTb/Filters.png[/img]

We have also revisited various tooltips and UI elements in the Design, Engineering, and Contract scenes to make [b]number management[/b] more transparent.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L8LM0fTj/UI-design.png[/img]

[b]Staff management[/b] has also been enhanced. You can now hire or fire employees from anywhere in the game, eliminating the need to visit the Administration each time.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/JnP85LQg/HR.png[/img]

[b]Design defects[/b] have also been revisited. They are now explained in greater detail, clearly distinguishing between crew-related issues and design limitations. Furthermore, addressing defects no longer requires travel to the [b]Proving Grounds[/b]; you can now handle amendments directly, albeit at a higher cost. Note, Proving Grounds is [u][b]temporarily[/b][/u] disabled until [b]new game mechanics[/b] are in place!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nzHZmzqB/M1921.png[/img]

We also did a good portion of bug hunting, balancing, and text corrections. Don’t forget to check at the complete Patch details below or check the update note directly from the game.

We continue to work further along the [b]Road Map[/b]. In the next update, you can expect some new exciting features to be added and even more countries to enter the tank race, enriching the Interwar tank portfolio even further. We are also steadily progressing towards the WW2 Era update, expect more news on that very soon!  

Happy New Year to All!


FunGI Team

Greetings, Arms Dealers!


[b]1.1.5.0 Patch[/b] is now available for you!

In accordance with our Roadmap, this patch introduces several exciting new features to the game. The [b]Design Assistant[/b] serves as a valuable tool for creating new tanks, displaying the tank roles currently sought by various countries and the requirements for each role.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/y8VLQMvP/Design-Assist.png[/img]

The [b]Espionage Centre[/b] enables you to view the tanks offered by your opponents. From this centre, you can acquire rival designs or procure tank trophies, provided you have sufficient funds.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wBrFB7Hf/Espionage.png[/img]

For [b]veteran players[/b], we have introduced a [b]Hardcore game[/b] mode that allows you to test your tycoon skills in a more challenging environment.

You can now test your design skills and determine if you can give this tank a second chance in the market and on the battlefield.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/XvqQ3wMB/LW.png[/img]

Additionally, significant efforts have been made to enhance quality of life features. Notably, you can now view all [b]active processes[/b] for your buildings and [b]idle employees[/b], allowing you to manage your company from anywhere within the game.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/T3CCZtsX/QOL.png[/img]

As always, we have conducted extensive [b]bug fixes, balancing adjustments[/b], and text corrections. 

The resource respawn rate has been increased, and accident risks have been reduced. Multiple components and modifications have been reviewed to enhance their appeal. Please review the complete patch details below or check the update notes directly within the game.

The team is committed to delivering the next content update promptly. You can look forward to [b]more countries[/b] joining the tank race, each adding new Interwar tanks to the game. Finally, we are actively developing content for the [b]World War II era[/b].

Thank you for being a part of this exciting journey with us.

FunGI Team

notes.title: Dev. Update: October
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers! 

With the [b]Interbellum expansion released[/b], the team is already hard at work on upcoming updates! In this dev blog, we’re excited to share what awaits us on our journey to the next major milestone: the [b]WWII expansion[/b]. 


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/CKCFXMgF/EA-Roadmap-2-2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Game Tutorial[/b]
[/list]     
Arms Trade Tycoon is a complex and unique game that requires time and effort to fully grasp its mechanics and enjoy the experience. To support all new players, we are thrilled to introduce a comprehensive tutorial to guide you through the key steps to becoming a successful Arms Trade Tycoon! This immersive tutorial is built around a specific WWI tank, making your learning experience even more engaging. Plus, upon completion, the tutorial will reward you with several bonuses that will carry over into the game!     
[list]
[*] [b]Design Assistant[/b]
[/list]
With over 20 different tank roles already in the game—and even more on the way—designing components or whole tanks to fit each role can be a daunting challenge. To make your job as a designer easier, we’re excited to introduce the Engineer Assistant! This helpful tool will guide you in selecting the right role and ensure that your designs are a perfect match!
[list]
[*] [b]Espionage centre [/b]
[/list]
Reverse engineering is one of the core mechanics that allows you to combine tank parts from different countries and eras. To reduce reliance on the randomness of trophies, we’re thrilled to introduce the Espionage Centre! Here, you'll be able to strategize your next industrial espionage moves and gain the upper hand over your rivals!     
[list]
[*] [b]USA joins the game[/b]
[/list]
The time has come to expand the world and unlock new territories across the Atlantic! Many new countries will join the race for the ultimate tank, with the USA leading the charge. Get ready for additional tanks in the Interwar Era, inspired by the American tank school!

[list]
[*] [b]World in flames [/b]
[/list]
With this feature implemented, countries can engage in global wars that engulf multiple territories and continents, stretching over months and even years. It’s the perfect environment to grow a successful Arms Tycoon!

[list]
[*] [b]Compatibility Assistant [/b]
[/list]
To streamline your planning for the ultimate tank design, we will introduce a tank component compatibility tool! This feature will allow you to plan already from the Research Bureau stage, helping you determine which tank components to focus on for maximum effectiveness!
[list]
[*] [b]Holdings for purchase [/b]
[/list]
This feature empowers players to invest their hard-earned capital and acquire a variety of assets from countries with high reputation ratings! The effects of these assets will vary, but each one will be a fantastic addition to your growing arms trade empire!
[list]
[*] [b]Russia joins the game [/b]
[/list]
The world expands once again, this time to the east! New countries are set to join the race for the ultimate tank, with Russia leading the charge. Get ready for additional tanks in the Interwar Era, inspired by the rich legacy of the Russian tank school!
[list]
[*] [b]Diplomacy centre[/b]
[/list]
With numerous potential countries now open for trade, it’s crucial to streamline the information available about each prospective customer. This feature will consolidate all that data into a single window, allowing you to effortlessly access vital details about every potential buyer for your tanks!
[list]
[*] [b]Decals and Camo[/b]
[/list]
This feature is fully dedicated to enhancing tank design mechanics! With its implementation, you'll be able to make your tanks truly unique by utilizing a variety of decals and an expanded portfolio of camouflage options!
[list]
[*] [b]Localizations [/b]
[/list]   
This addition has been highly requested on our Steam forums and Discord server! With the WWII update on the horizon, it's the perfect time to expand language support and enhance the gaming experience for those who prefer to play in languages other than English
[list]
[*] [b]Free WW2 expansion pack[/b]
[/list]
This is the next major free update for the game that will introduce a lot of new content – the World War 2 Era! Gameplay time will be again extended, many new tanks will join the game, including some of the most iconic WWII models.


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6QxWM2Fj/Little-Willie.png[/img]

We plan is to roll out these features across several updates, with WWII being the [b]next major content[/b] expansion pack! Please note that the order of these features may change as we progress toward the [b]WWII era[/b].

Once again, we wanted to thank you all for your support and feedback. Stay tuned for our upcoming development blogs!



[b]FunGI Team[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.4.1
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

The [b]Hotfix 1.1.4.1 patch[/b] is now ready, and we are happy to share it with you! 

This update focuses on the most urgent issues that were discovered, such as progression from Tier 1 to Tier 2, contract “starvation” at certain periods, excessive attribute demands for certain contracts, excessive company upkeep, and several other issues.
With these changes, we hope that your experience will be more enjoyable. Please see the detailed list of changes below.

Thank you for providing your feedback and your patience with this patch!

FunGI Team

[*] Increased achievement point generation with a special focus on unlocking research nodes and fulfilled contracts.

[*] Removed the “soft lock” from loan negotiation; the bank fee no longer locks new loan deals.
[*] Revisited “True Tycoon” difficulty settings.
[*] Specified which “design limits” are exceeded instead of displaying a generic message in the Design window.
[*] Countries are now less “aggressive” regarding attribute demand growth for new contracts.
[*] The grace period after a fire is increased to 120 days.
[*] Edited the contract window by adding a “Deadline Days” value under the time proposal slider.
[*] Removed “Gunner” requirements from turrets.

notes.title: Interwar Content Update released
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

We are very excited to share with you the [b]Interwar Content Update[/b]!

With the Great War behind, the tank engineers have accumulated enough knowledge to perfect the original and clunky tank designs and prepare them for the wars to come. Follow their tracks or design your own tank combining the technologies of WW1 and the Interwar era!

[b]Update Summary:[/b]
[list]
[*] 10 new vehicles added including British, French, and German tanks

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/8P2M7sFR/Bild4.png[/img]

[*] A total of 120+ research nodes introducing new components, modifications, and expendables

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/8PJLkLCk/Bild3.png[/img]
[*] Possibility to combine and mix components from Great War and Interwar periods

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/cJmnkmFh/Bild5.png[/img]
[*] Tank role roster expanded with 11 new roles to account for Interwar vehicles 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MT3jqG2j/Bild7.png[/img]
[*] Expanded factory ground functionality with new facilities, new administrator characters, and additional process lines to pipeline your activities 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/d0vC9XjD/Bild2.png[/img]

[*] Multiple QoL improvements including quick travel buttons, filter and sorting options, design and component series

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Tw3WzDS6/Bild6.png[/img]
[*] Possibility to select the Start era of your game
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Dw1sLFst/Bild1.png[/img]
Embark on the next chapter of tank history and become the true Tank Tycoon!
[/list]

[b]Patch content[/b]

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Interwar Era content added with new, iconic British, German, and French tanks.
[*] Expanded Research tree to 120+ nodes
[*] Added the possibility of starting the game directly from Era 2.
[*] Introduced 11 new tank roles for the Interwar era.
[*] Introduced simplified power-to-weight mechanics to eliminate the "light" engine exploit.
[*] Added fame for tank series to allocate fame between designs.
[*] Expanded factors affecting individual tank fame.
[*] Added a new music track.
[*] Introduced a "quick travel" button for specific events to simplify navigation.
[*] Improved bank loan mechanics, allowing re-negotiation of deals with banks.
[*] Added a “numerical superiority” bonus for tactical battles reflecting regiment unit count.
[*] Enabled dynamic selection of the best available alloys and assembly types for new engineered structure components.
[*] Added double and triple primary weapon mounts for turrets in the Interwar era.
[*] Added smoke particles to tank exhaust in Test Drive mode.
[*] Added a new type of expendable: Oil.
[*] Added the ability to use spaces in the "new player" window.
[*] Introduced a button "fold all" in the design/component list to fold with one click all series
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Exchanged the crew bonus for an attribute bonus from the “Internal Comm” modification to avoid negative crew requirement situations.
[*] Restocked contract logic revisited. 
[*] Rebalanced man-hour costs for engineering projects.
[*] Introduced a mark for modifications that are already unlocked via other nodes in the research tree.
[*] Rebalanced research costs to account for the 120+ new research nodes of the Interwar era.
[*] Introduced a limit for component and tank attribute values; negative values are no longer allowed.

notes.title: Dev. Update: August
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers! 

In anticipation of the release of the [b]Interbellum update[/b] we have kept mostly quiet working diligently to make it the best it can be, and we wanted to thank you for your patience. We are ready to show more of the future update that will soon hit the experimental build! 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/x1sKv7CV/PIC1.png[/img]

As mentioned, we’ve been working as hard as ever on the update and wanted to showcase our progress. Here you can see many new parts unique to the update that was made to fit and be as cross-compatible as possible, including but not limited to the [b]Vickers No. 1[/b], [b]Independent Landship[/b], and [b]Char B1[/b] tanks

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Lsb3p7K3/PIC2.png[/img]

In addition, for experienced players who already know the game well, we will add the ability to [b]start directly in the new era[/b], in 1921. This is not recommended for first-time players due to the increase in complexity and difficulty.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/90GdyQ4L/PIC3.png[/img]

On top of new tanks and parts, the update also brings:
[list]
[*] New administrators, each with their own bonuses.
[*] New facility upgrades as well as a new look to bring them into the new era
[*] Additional process lines to existing buildings 
[*] Multiple revisions to building upgrades and maintenance costs
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Gt0PBypB/PIC4.png[/img]

With new parts also comes new research. The tech tree has been greatly expanded and rebalanced for a better player experience and the ability to transition from the First World War to the Interbellum era. There are now more than [b]120 research nodes[/b] available to aspiring Arms Dealers!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vHsLbfjk/PIC5.png[/img]

As always, you can [b]customize[/b] all your tank components as you see fit. Using parts from both eras you can create the best or weirdest weapons of war the world has ever seen.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/c4B7H6GH/PIC6.png[/img]

A new era also means new challenges! As the new chapter of history opens for countries of the world, they will update their military forces and change their doctrines accordingly. New tank roles to fill and opponents to confront are sure to arise to make use of modern tank technologies.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/HLVbB2cc/PIC7.png[/img]

Apart from the new content we’ve also worked on various [b]quality-of-life features[/b] that were demanded by player feedback, such as:
[list]
[*] Filters and sorting options for a variety of screens
[*] Fast travel buttons
[*] Flexible bank loans
[*] New tank series display and options
[*] Improved modification classifications and naming
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/T1qbpNSS/PIC8.png[/img]

We plan to start [b]monthly development blogs[/b] to better keep you all up to date with the state of future updates. We want to get the Interbellum update into experimental testing within next weeks, and afterward continue onto other content updates.

notes.title: Patch V 1.1.3.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

[b]1.1.3.0 Patch[/b] is finally available for you!

This patch introduces a lot of changes to the game with the focus on [b]tank contracts[/b] and [b]relation building[/b] with the customer countries. The tank design process has also been revisited, allowing players to [b]tweak the armour protection[/b] of structural components and making tank [b]“cloning”[/b] a more playable option.

More efforts have also been spent on the QoL side, with the most prominent ones being the possibility to [b]advance time from anywhere[/b] in the game, [b]addition of various filters and sorting options[/b] and enriching multiple tooltips with useful info. Components have been the subject of a major overhaul, resulting in [b]more variation between individual modifications[/b].

As always, we also did a good portion of [b]bug hunting and corrections[/b]. Please, have a look at the complete Patch details below or check the update note directly from the game.

Last but not least, the [b][u]next update (1.1.4.0)[/u][/b] will finally introduce something that many have been requesting - a totally new content, the [b]Interbellum tanks[/b]. The tanks that will be added are an interesting mix of rare and iconic tanks from the Interwar epoch and we truly hope that you will enjoy them as you progress through the game.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/43n3pSS3/Vickers1-Mark8.png[/img]

The team is working diligently to bring you the [b][u]next update as soon as possible[/u][/b]. However, in order to ensure a polished and high-quality release, we must shift the timeline slightly. You can expect the update to be available in the near future.

We greatly appreciate your continued understanding and patience.

FunGI Team

[b]Update 1.1.3.0 content:[/b]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Country diplomacy is revisited. A new, tier reputation system is introduced with various negotiation options coupled to reputation tier of the country

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/YChLM0z0/Diplomacy.png[/img]

[*] Reputation points are added to the game. These points are acquired by successful fulfilling the contracts, generated by several new facilities, administrator perks or attained as achievement rewards
[*] Armor thickness of structural components is now adjustable from the Engineering Bureaux. Note that extra protection comes at higher mass and production costs!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/15RN7Jgp/Armor.png[/img]

[*] Contract system is revisited:
[list]
[*] Contract lobbying is now introduced. Depending on your reputation Tier with the contract, you can initiate limited number of tank contracts if the conditions are met. This feature is accessible from the diplomacy screen of the corresponding country
[*] Introduced cancellation mechanics. Now, you can cancel, at any time, the accepted contract and monetise delivered tanks at the cost of the cancellation fee. Note, this fee is dynamic and will increase as the contract approached the deadline
[*] Introduced delay mechanics. Now, you can miss several days past the promised deadline at the cost of the delay fee. This fee depends on the promised amount of tanks and agreed price. Note, maximum delay is currently set at 30 days
[*] Contracts now feature not only focus groups but also focus attributes that are deemed more important for the employed tank roles. Make sure to comply to contracts requirements to maximize the attractiveness of your tank designs
[*] Added multiple tooltips and explanation, providing details for all new contract features

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/g2QXJpgD/Contracts.png[/img]

[/list]
[*] Revisited attribute contract requirements, effectively eliminating inconsistent attribute requests
[*] New type of contract, Upgrade contract, is introduced. This contract is triggered if the employed tank design has been deemed outdated and will allow the player to upgrade the equipment of the already formed tank regiments
[*] Age for tank’s components and design is introduced and coupled to the Upgrade contract mechanics
[*] 7 new tank roles have been added to Britain allowing for more variation in country’s contract demands between various playthroughs
[*] Added new Administrators to the game
[*] Added Filters and Sorting options for Design and Engineering scenes

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/R0t3JY8z/Filters.png[/img]
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Time progression can now be activated from any scene, including “Global Map”. There is no longer need to go outside to the “Factory View” to access the Time control!
[*] Man hour cost of the cloned tank design is now proportional to the amount of changes introduced in the tank. A minimum cost is though always applied.
[*] “Clone” button is now locked for designed that have not been completed
[*] Administrator hiring is now a part of diplomatic negotiation and, as such, moved to diplomacy screen
[*] Restyling of tank crew members has been performed. Each role has unique uniform and player is given an opportunity to select the crew member face
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/tCrnKWP8/Crew.png[/img]
[*] Revisited Trophies:
[list]
[*] Purchased trophy tanks now disappear from the diplomacy window
[*] Each trophy tank displays how many new, undiscovered tank components it holds to simplify the decision
[/list]
[*] Monetary and reputation income for Supply, Re-stock and Upgrade contract has been revisited:
[list]
[*] Supply contract yields maximum reputational and average monetary gains
[*] Re-stock contract yields high reputational and high monetary gains 
[*] Supply contract yields average reputational and very high monetary gains 
[/list]
[*] Clarified cost requirements for the corresponding scene (For example: engineering cost in Engineering scene)
[*] Display explicitly the chance of the resource delay in the Warehouse
[*] Success score is now coloured directly in “red” or “green” after the insight info on the competitor offer is purchased
[/list]


[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed rival tanks design that we not respecting the max weight limits
[*] Fixed the bug when tanks had different attributes between the design and the contract scenes
[*] Fixed the bug that was causing defect corrections to be unaccounted for contract attributes
[*] Correct the issues that caused the killed soldiers to be  "resurrected" after a draw battle outcome
[*] Addressed a mini-tutorial bug that sometimes caused a crush when transitioning to scenes after pressing the "Proceed" button
[*] Fixed the issue causing tank attributes in Production building to display the attribute without defects penalties
[*] Corrected the glitch that broke the UI on some occasions after creating and instantly removing tank design
[*] Corrected in-game patch notes layout fixed
[*] Fixed missing recoil modifications on some weapons
[*] Fixed snapshot maker. Hide ghost design when snapshot in progress
[*] Secured contracts not give points in Achievement Score
[*] Fixed an issue with the “” marker when cloning a tank design and clicking on the save/assign button to the original design instead of the cloned one
[*] Addressed the issue causing the design components to be reset when reselecting the hull
[*] Fixed the bug that, upon loading a save game, led to wrong number of the unread contracts
[*] Fixed an issue with the delayed tank shipments
[*] Fixed a bug when several Admins perks were not properly affecting the corresponding processes
[*] Resolved an issue that, upon loading a save game, highlighted two buttons on the time controller (x1 and x10)
[*] Fixed a bug with failed create component preview for Armoured Plate
[*] Resolved a bug triggered by clicking the “cross” in the incident window message
[*] Fixed an exploit that resulted in full refund of the design cost  if the player double-clicked the "Save" button on a cloned design
[*] Fixed black colour of tanks when playing on low quality
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the cloned component  to “lose” some modification on the component picture
[*] Fixed random wrong sockets cam position
[*] Added gun depression/elevation for the 75mm Blockhaus-Schneider Gun in a Sponson of a British Tank
[*] Unified date format for all scenes and windows

[*] Fixed the camera for Central Cab MK2 component
[*] Fixed the issue that caused the facility card to remain visible even after closing the card

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/8cPCwfXB/Admin.png[/img]

More tanks will join the portfolio including French FT-17, Saint Chamond and maybe more!

Stay tuned for more announcement about the date and other details!

notes.title: Dev Update: April
notes.content:
Greetings!

Time for our monthly Update. 
Today we want to share with you some of the progress that has been done since last time. Some of the improvements and changes you can already find in Development Build or that will be added very soon.

[b]Factory Grounds:[/b]
[list]
[*] We continue to work on the [b]Facilities[/b]. Each Facility and its upgrade are getting a unique look that reflects its purpose. Some of the Facilities will affect all Buildings while others will offer unique bonuses to certain Buildings. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9QSCjgXj/Power-Units-1.jpg[/img]

[*] Arms Trade Tycoon Tanks is a game about tanks, but the Tycoon part requires other types of vehicles to be present in the game. Vehicles that you won’t design or sell, but you will see them in your Factory Grounds, standing still near the buildings or moving along the roads. It is these details or “props”, that make the game experience more immersive, atmospheric and engage the players in new ways. Today, we want to show you some new [b]Truck models[/b]  that you will find when playing for Britain.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/rwzM32kJ/Trucks-Screenshots-01.jpg[/img]

 [*] Without a doubt, the [b]Production Hall[/b] will determine the prosperity of your Tycoon Empire. Here you will mass produce your tanks and ensure that you have the appropriate Workshops for the intricacy of your tanks design. 
We believe that, given its significance, this building merits special attention. Many references were studied, and a lot of work was put into the "props" to give the interior scene a realistic look. Finally, the lighting was completely redone to make the scene both atmospheric and immersive.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/tJ27dd3C/Production-1.png[/img]

[/list]
[b] Engineering Workshop:[/b]
[list]
[*] Already in the next Dev. Build you will be able to experience a “first shot” at the [b]Reverse-Engineering[/b].
We have talked about it for some time and now you’ll finally able to dismantle some German tanks and use their parts to construct your own curse patterns! 
For the time being you’ll be able to tinker with Sturmpanzerwagen [b] A7V[/b] and [b]LK2[/b] but this is just the beginning, more to come soon!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/j2srhGcy/Reverse-Engineering-Screenshots-01.png[/img]

[*] We continue to add new tank component to the game. Already with the next update to the Development Build, you will be able to employ a predecessor for QF 6 pounder Hotchkiss gun!
Light but deadly – the [b]QF 6 pounder Nordenfelt[/b] gun is a welcomed addition to your arsenal.

Note that this gun should not be confused with the short-barreled 57 mm Cockerill-Nordenfelt which was employed to arm the German A7V tank and which will be added to the game! 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/m2Lb3FpK/QF-6-Pounder-Nordenfelt-1-1.jpg[/img]

[*] We should also want to highlight two new features already accessible in the Dev. Build! Namely, various [b]assembly[/b]" and [b]armour plating types[/b]" available for you tanks. 

During the engineering process you can chose what assembly process suits your needs best for any Hull or Turret component. This is a compromise that you must make between production costs and attributes for your tanks. Would you select riveted assembly to speed up your production but sacrifice crew safety or go for welded components? The choice is yours!

Currently, you can select bolted and riveted assemblies, but welding and casting are also in the pipeline.

In a similar way, you can select between various armour alloys. Here the compromise is between production costs and what type of protection you need for your vehicle. Should your tank have a better chance against AP rounds or is HESH rounds that you need to be afraid off? Make sure to consider what enemies your tanks might face on the battlefield! The outcome of the entire military campaign may depend on your choice! 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L6xmx6r5/Bolts.jpg[/img]
[/list]

Hope you liked the update!

Don't forget to [b]wishlist the game[/b] and join our Discord channel for weekly updates:
[url=]discord.com/invite/cHdwDzd[/url] 

FunGI Team

[*] Fixed dubious fate of the mysterious “father” - he has now gone consistently missing
[*] Decreased financial penalty for undelivered tanks
[*] Decreased default number of requested tanks per contract
[*] Attribute adjustments for “Track” modifiers
[*] Relaxed contract request for attributes from the Hard Attack group
[*] Fixed inconsistency in crew demand for 3-pounder, 6-pounder and 6-pounder 6cwt guns
